items.briefing:
A cyber operation has been identified targeting South Korean media and automotive sectors, serving as a timely reminder that industry-specific attacks are becoming more common across the Asia Pacific region — Australian organisations in similar sectors should stay alert. Separately, new research highlights that "containment" is increasingly critical to cyber resilience, meaning that limiting how far an attacker can move through your systems after a breach is just as important as preventing one in the first place.

On a positive note, a survey found Asia Pacific users now prioritise fraud protection over transaction speed — a healthy attitude for staff handling financial processes or transfers.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected request to transfer funds or change payment details, always verify it through a separate, known contact method before acting.
